messages:
samir: Ran into a weird UX bug during a customer demo: if you kill the JS or Python sample app while the server is streaming, the UI sometimes shows broken JSON. Seems like partial SSE events are emitted on shutdown.
hannah: Can you paste the minimal logs/repro?
samir: Repro is simple: start sampleapp, trigger a long stream, then ctrl+c ~150-300ms after tokens begin. Logs I saw: 
```
[info] stream opened /v1/stream
[debug] recv: data: {\"text\":\" He\"\n[debug] SIGINT
[debug] flush remaining -> \"llo\"
[error] JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
samir: Browser shows a parse error and the UI renders a truncated object. Python sample logs "truncated token" and exits non-zero.
mike: That tracks with parser.finalize() emitting leftover buffer even when no \n\n delimiter is present. If auth refresh triggers a reconnect at the same time, reconnect replay can push the same fragment twice -> duplicates.
hannah: Proposed fixes: 1) Parser: on finalize only emit if buffer contains a full SSE event (endsWith('\n\n') or contains a complete data block). Otherwise drop buffer and debug-log. 2) Sampleapps: add gracefulShutdown() on SIGINT/beforeunload that polls parser.inFlight for up to 150ms before force-close (avoid arbitrary sleep). 3) Dev/demo opt-in: DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false to avoid instructor demos crashing. 4) UX: catch JSON.parse from streams and render "Stream ended early: partial output omitted."
mike: I'll add unit tests to the parser for mid-chunk aborts + auth-reconnect interleaving and a small runtime integration that simulates auth refresh during a client SIGINT.
samir: I'll open two tiny PRs: sampleapps (JS/Python) and parser+tests. Will include a quick repro script: 
```
# repro.sh
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" http://localhost:8000/stream | sed -u 's/^/RECV:/ &'
PID=$!
sleep 0.2
kill -INT $PID
```
infra-bot: Note: no blocking deploys; small PRs OK to land.
hannah: Thanks. Tag me on PRs and let's add a short devex onboarding note describing recommended demo shutdown steps to reduce support noise.
